## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-2009. The pricing-engine pods are crashing due to **a corrupted pricing rule in the rules database** (rule BF-2026-STACKED), not a Kubernetes issue. The application panics during startup when trying to compile this rule due to an array index out-of-bounds error. The fix requires the pricing team to identify and correct the invalid rule configuration in the rules-admin service.
